query_scope: metadata table only; no entity-level environmental values
selection_rule: case-insensitive fixed regex over concatenated metadata fields; freeze every matching metadata row, do not choose among candidates in this execution
if_candidates_found: a later separate revision must select the geological-origin variable and category mapping before querying entity-level values
if_no_candidates_found: do not substitute GMMC as geological origin; either obtain a separate response-independent origin source or downgrade origin to an unavailable adjustment explicitly before species access
forbidden: selecting an origin variable because it improves C-minus-R3
